requirements.text: The portal should allow patients to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions through the portal.
A verification process is necessary to confirm patients' identities before accessing their health information.
There should be a way to flag urgent cases for immediate attention.
Test results should be available online only after a clinician has reviewed them, to prevent misunderstandings.
Support options, such as contact methods and tutorials, should be available for patients needing assistance.
